description: This file defines an abstract PHP class 'FormBase' which provides common functionality for handling form operations in SuiteCRM. It contains methods to determine if a save operation was triggered from a specific menu or if certain request parameters are empty, supporting form processing and UI behaviors.

classes.name: FormBase
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a base for form handling in SuiteCRM, providing utility methods to check request context related to form submissions.

methods.name: isSaveFromDCMenu
methods.description: Checks whether the form save operation was triggered from the DCMenu shortcut bar, by inspecting the POST data.

methods.name: isEmptyReturnModuleAndAction
methods.description: Determines if the request lacks 'return_module' and 'return_action' parameters, indicating a save action without navigation changes, useful for AJAX updates or inline operations.
